9.stimulus:
Intensity: RPE 8 (climbing ladder, DU breaks keep the heart rate up)
Loading: Moderate
9.strategy:
DB Front Squats: unbroken up to the rung of 12, then 2 sets
Pull Ups: small sets from the rung of 9, break before failure
Double Unders: unbroken, one breath before you start
Transitions: rope next to the DBs, start the DU on the beep
Goal: steady climb, no long rests under the bar

9.stimulus:
Intensity: RPE 7 (steady threshold pace, same split every round)
Loading: Moderate
9.strategy:
Run: steady, about 1:45–2:00
Sit-Ups: unbroken, steady breathing
Suitcase Carry: unbroken between switches, walk fast
Transitions: KB and abmat ready before the run
Goal: 4:30 or less every round, same split in round 5

9.stimulus:
Intensity: RPE 7-8 (steady hard rounds of about 2:30)
Loading: Moderate
9.strategy:
Wall Walks: steady, rest on the feet, not in the handstand
DB Snatch: unbroken, switch arms every rep
Box Jumps: step down, steady rhythm
Transitions: straight from the wall to the DB
Goal: about 2:30 per round, finish under 13min

9.stimulus:
Intensity: RPE 8-9 (short sprint after the technique work)
Loading: Light-Moderate
9.strategy:
Wall Balls: 30 in 2 sets (20/10), 24 and 18 unbroken if possible
Burpees: steady pace, no stops
Transitions: ball stays at your feet, burpees right next to it
Goal: under 7min

9.stimulus:
Intensity: RPE 8 (12 minutes of hard continuous work)
Loading: Light-Moderate
9.strategy:
Row: hard first 40s, then settle in
Push Jerks: sets of 5 with quick resets
T2B: sets of 4-5 from the start
Push Ups: sets of 8-10, break before failure
Goal: keep moving, about 60 reps per round

9.stimulus:
Intensity: RPE 7-8 (30 minutes of steady hard work with partner rest)
Loading: Moderate
9.strategy:
Hang Power Snatch: 8 unbroken or 5-3
Goblet Squats: unbroken
V-Ups: unbroken or 6-6
Row: push hard, the round on the other side is your rest
Transitions: fast switch, rower stays set up
Goal: about 1:15 per round, same split for all 30 min

9.stimulus:
Intensity: RPE 8 (steady repeated rounds of about 1:40)
Loading: Light-Moderate
9.strategy:
C2B: 6-5 or 4-4-3 from round 1
Front Squats: 22 unbroken or 12-10
Transitions: bar right next to the pull-up bar
Goal: about 1:40 per round

10.stimulus:
Intensity: RPE 8, steady ~14min, the run is the only place to breathe
Loading: moderate, thrusters unbroken per arm
10.strategy:
Run: same pace every round, ~2:00
Thrusters: 6 + 6 unbroken, switch arms without putting the DB down
Lunges: 6 per side unbroken, short steps, DB stays racked
Transitions: DB at the start line
Goal: under 14min, every round within 10s

10.stimulus:
Intensity: RPE 7, skill under light fatigue, quality muscle ups over speed
Loading: moderate, hang power cleans touch and go
10.strategy:
Ring Muscle Ups: singles from round 1, reset the kip every rep
Hang Power Cleans: 4 unbroken, fast elbows
Double Unders: unbroken or 2 sets, breathe before you start
Goal: 10+ rounds, ~1:50 per round

10.stimulus:
Intensity: RPE 8, ~14-16min, steady on the burpees, faster as the reps drop
Loading: moderate KB for the swings, twists without weight
10.strategy:
Burpee Box Step-Ups: steady rhythm, step up and down, no jumping
KBS: 25 = 15 + 10, 20 = 12 + 8, then unbroken
Russian Twists: unbroken, feet down if needed
Goal: under 16min

10.stimulus:
Intensity: RPE 7, stamina, 5 repeatable rounds with ~30s rest
Loading: heavy DBs for the march
10.strategy:
Row: ~1:00 at a pace you could hold for all 5 rounds
T2B: split early (8 + 7), never to failure
March: no rush, tall posture, knees to hip height
Goal: ~2:30 per round, the same time every round
Accessory: slow and controlled

10.stimulus:
Intensity: plyo max intent with full rest; WOD RPE 8, ~1:45 of man makers every round
Loading: light DB, every man maker the same quality
10.strategy:
Ring Dips: unbroken or 3 + 3
Air Squats: unbroken and fast to buy time
Man Makers: steady pace, one every ~12s, no rest at the top
Goal: 6+ man makers per round, the same score every round

10.stimulus:
Intensity: RPE 7, lactate threshold, ~25min team effort
Loading: moderate DBs
10.strategy:
Runs: together, at the slower partner's pace
Pull Ups: sets of 5-10, switch often
DB Deadlifts: 10 / 10
Sit-Ups: 20 / 20
Goal: under 26min

10.stimulus:
Intensity: RPE 5-6, long aerobic, 45-60min
Loading: light vest or ruck (20/14kg)
10.strategy:
Switch the leading leg every 10 reps
Break it into sets of 50, a sip of water every 200
Pace: ~20 step-ups per minute, ~50min
RPE 5 option: 500 step-ups, no vest
